_comment: Example benchmark configuration file. Copy to config.json and modify as needed.
_usage: cp config.example.json config.json && BENCH_CONFIG=./config.json BENCHMARK_REPORT_DIR=./reports go test . -bench=BenchmarkRealisticTrading_Custom -benchtime=1x -run '^$' -v
_presets: base_preset may be: light, heavy, extended, extreme.
_zero_values: Numeric fields can be set to 0 to disable features (e.g. derivative_markets_count, batch_order_pct). Omit a field to use the base preset's default value.
_comment_seed: random_seed makes runs deterministic. Omit it (or set 0) for non-deterministic runs.
_comment_gas: tx_gas_limit controls base GasWanted per tx (benchmark adds small headroom; batch messages may scale higher).
_comment_batch: Batch operations (market maker style order placement). batch_size is total orders per batch message (capped at 100).
_comment_account: Account operations (% of blocks to include these operations)
_comment_expiry: Order expiration (% of limit orders with expiration block)
